name: Defender for Cloud / How long resources have been unhealthy
text:
// Adapted from 'Time Indicators' by Microsoft (https://github.com/Azure/Microsoft-Defender-for-Cloud/tree/main/Kusto/Azure%20Resource%20Graph/Time%20Indicators), MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
SecurityResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| where tostring(properties.status.code) =~ 'unhealthy'
| extend FirstEvaluated = todatetime(properties.status.firstEvaluationDate), UnhealthySince = todatetime(properties.status.statusChangeDate)
| extend DaysUnhealthy = datetime_diff('day', now(), UnhealthySince)
| project DaysUnhealthy, UnhealthySince, FirstEvaluated, Severity = tostring(properties.metadata.severity), Recommendation = tostring(properties.displayName), Resource = tolower(substring(id, 0, indexof(id, '/providers/Microsoft.Security/assessments/'))), subscriptionId
| order by DaysUnhealthy desc
